steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Satellites orbit Earth for communications, navigation, weather forecasting, Earth observation and scientific research | Key Fact: Geostationary orbit: 35,786 km above the equator, 24-hour period, satellite appears stationary — used for comms and weather | Key Fact: Low Earth orbit (LEO): 160–2,000 km, ~90-minute period — used for Earth observation and the ISS | Key Fact: Polar orbit: passes over the poles, allowing full Earth coverage — used for mapping and reconnaissance

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from satellites &amp; space probes, and one past-paper question.
